chapter.verse: Keima kiangah nong khak uh lai sung thu in, pasal in numei tawh kiteeng kei leh, a hoih hi.
Ahi zongin numei tawh mawhna thute hangin pasal khempeuh in zi nei ciat uh hen. Numei khempeuh in zong pasal nei ciat uh hen.
Pasal in a bawl ding a kilawm bang a zi tungah hih ta hen. Tua mah bangin numei in a bawl ding a kilawm bang a pasal tungah hih ta hen.
A zi in ama pumpi uk lo hi, a pasal in a uk hi. Pasal in ama pumpi uk lo hi, a zi in a uk hi.

Thungen dingin na lungsim uh kikhatin, tawlkhat bek tan’na longal note in khat leh khat na kinial kei un. Tua ahih ciangin na pum uh na kham zawh lohna uh hangah Satan in hong zol loh nadingin, a nung ciangin omkhawm kik un.
Ahih hangin thukham hi loin thupiakna bek hangin hi bangin kong gen hi.
Mi khempeuh in kei tawh kibangin om le-uh ka awi hi. Ahi zongin mi khempeuh in Pasian’ piakna mah bangin atuamtuam thupha a ngah ciat uh hi.
Zi nei lo, pasal nei lo, leh meigong numeite kiangah ka cih-inah, amaute in keimah bangin a om uh leh, a pha ding hi.
Ahi zongin a pumpi uh a kikham zawh kei uh leh, kiteeng uh hen. A kat sangin kiteeng leh a phazaw hi.
Zi nei, pasal neite tungah kei thukham hi lo Pasian’ thukham in, zi in a pasal ma kei hen.
A mak leh, pasal dang nei loin om hen. Ahih kei leh, a pasal tawh kilemin omkik hen. Pasal in zong a zi ma kei hen.
Midangte kiangah Pasian’ thukham hi lo, keima cihna in: unau khat in thu-um lo zi nei a, a zi in a pasal kiangah om nuam ahih leh, kikhen kei uh hen.
Tua mah bangin numei in thu-um lo pasal nei a, pasal in a zi kiangah om nuam ahih leh kikhen kei uh hen.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, thu-um lo pasal in a zi hangin a siangtho hi. Thu-um lo zi in a unau hangin a siangtho hi. Ahih kei leh, na tate uh a siangtho kei ding uh hi. Tu-in ahih leh, a siangtho uh hi.

Ahi zongin thu-um lo mi in kikhen a ut leh, kikhen ta hen. Tua bang ahih leh, sanggampa ahi zongin, sanggamnu ahi zongin kihencipna om lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh, eite in kilem a, om nadingin Pasian in hong sam zo hi.
Zi aw, nang na pasal na gup theih ding, na gup theih loh ding bangci theih na hi hiam? Pasal aw, na zi na gup theih ding, na gup theih loh ding bangci theih na hi hiam?
Topa in mi khempeuh hawmsak a, Pasian in mi khempeuh a sapna thu tawh kituakin mi khempeuh in gamta uh hen. Pawlpi khempeuh kiangah hih thukham ka pia hi.
Vunat mi hong sap leh, vunat loh mi suak kei hen. Vunat loh mi hong sap leh, vun ki-atsak kei hen.
Vunatna hangin phattuamna om lo hi; vunat lohna hangin phattuamna om lo hi; Pasian’ thupiaknate zuihna hang bekin phattuamna a om hi.
A hong sap lai taka a om bangin mi khempeuh om ta uh hen.
Sila na hihna-ah hong sam hiam? Hong sap leh, lunghimawh kei in. Ahih hangin suahtakna na ngah theih leh, suahtakna la zaw in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh, sila ahihna-ah Topa’ sapna a ngah mi in Topa-ah suakta mi ahi hi. Tua mah bangin to neih lohna pan sapna a ngah mi in Khazih’ sila ahi hi.
Note in man tawh a kilei zo mi na hi uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin mite’ sila suak kei un.
Ute naute aw, hong sap laitaka na om bangun mi khempeuh in Pasian’ adingin omsuak ta uh hen.
Nungakte thu panin, Topa’ thupiakna ka ngah loh hangin mipha ka hih nadingin Topa’ hehpihna a ngah mi bangin thu ka pia hi.
Tua ka thupiakna in tu laitak a, kithuak bawlsiatna hangin, mi in a om bangbangin om leh, pha-in ka um hi.
Zi na neih leh, kikhen nading na ngaihsun kei in. Zi tawh na kikhen leh, zi zongkik kei in.

Ahih hangin zi na neih leh, mawhna om lo hi. Nungak in pasal a neih leh, mawhna om lo hi. Ahih hangin tua bang a neite in amau pum tungah haksatna thuak ding uh hi. Tua bang na thuak ding uh ka deih kei hi.
Ute naute aw, ke’n kong cih-inah, a hun a tom ahih ciangin zi neite in a nei lo mah bang ding uh hi,
a kapte in a kap lo mah bang ding uh hi; a lungdamte in a lungdam lo mah bang ding uh hi;
sumleite in bangmah nei lo mah bang ding uh hi; hih leitung a zangte in a zang lo mah bang ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, hih leitung’ lim leh meel in a mangthang ding uh hi.
Note in lunghihmawhna tawh na kipelh nading uh ka ut hi. Zi nei lo mi in Pasian lungdamsak nadingin Pasian’ thu a ngaihsun hi.
Zi nei mi ahih leh, a zi lungdamsak nadingin leitung thu a ngaihsun hi.

Tua mah bangin pasal a nei numei leh pasal a nei lo numei in kilamdang uh hi. Pasal nei lo numei in a pumpi leh a lungsim a siangtho nadingin Pasian’ thu a ngaihsun hi. Pasal a nei numei ahih leh, a pasal a lungdamsak nadingin leitung thu a ngaihsun hi.

Tua bang ka cih ciangin note noptuam nadingin ka ci hi. Note tungah thang kam dingin ka gen kei hi. Note in a kituak na gamtat uh a, lungsim buaina om loin Pasian na biak theih nading bekun ci-in ka hong gen hi.

Nungak in pasal nei loin a khangham luat leh, a kilawm kei hi ci-in tua nungak a nei mi in ngaihsun a, kiten’ pihsak nop a neih leh, tua mi in a deih bangin hih ta hen; khialhna a om kei hi, kiteengsak hen.
Ahih hangin a lungsim kip nei a, kulsakna nei lo a, ahih nop bang ahih theih ding thu thei a, a nungakna lim takin kem zo ning ci-in a lungsim sungah a khen zo mi in a hoih a gamta hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a tanu a kiteengsak mi in a hoih a gamta hi. A kiteengsak lo mi in a hoihzaw a gamta hi.
A zi in a pasal a nuntak laitengin a pasal tawh kihenin a om hi. A pasal a sih leh, a deih bangin midangte tawh a kiten’ theih hangin a lawmpa in Topa’ mi hi ding hi.
Ahih hangin a om mah bangin a om lai leh, a lungdamzaw ding hi ci-in ka um hi. Pasian’ Kha Siangtho ka nei hi, ci-in ka ki-um hi.
